title: Agent-native developer tools
promise: Build the tools that make agent-run companies easier to build and trust.
description: We turn recurring software-building problems into reusable tools: connecting systems, defining work, checking releases and making outputs inspectable. The portfolio is a proving ground, not evidence that every tool is already in use.
valueTest: A tool earns its place when a builder completes a real task more reliably or with less intervention.
learnFrom: Release reproducibility, time to a verified result and repeat use.

title: AI for health optimization
promise: Make health research clearer, more practical and easier to question.
description: These projects organize evidence, provider information and everyday habits around informed decisions. They help people ask better questions without turning generated content into diagnosis or treatment.
valueTest: A person finds a useful, source-grounded answer or next step with limitations intact.
learnFrom: Useful answers, return use, source freshness and safety-review outcomes.

title: AI transformation for SMBs
promise: Put domain expertise to work in specific business workflows.
description: Small businesses need finished work, not abstract AI capability. We focus on a narrow operating job, make its inputs and acceptance criteria explicit, and learn which workflows create repeat value.
valueTest: A business accepts a completed workflow or decision artifact that saves work or improves an operating decision.
learnFrom: Accepted outcomes, delivery cost, time to value and repeat demand.

title: Growth and commerce
promise: Help businesses explain their value and earn the next customer.
description: Websites, visual proof, product stories and distribution become more useful when they connect to a buying decision. These products test how credible presentation and follow-through turn attention into qualified demand.
valueTest: A buyer-facing asset or permissioned distribution workflow is delivered and its effect can be measured.
learnFrom: Qualified conversations, accepted deliveries, contribution and retained customers.

title: Everyday life and learning
promise: Use AI to make useful everyday actions easier.
description: Families, learners and households need fewer dead ends between information and action. We build around practical coordination, hands-on learning, meaningful records and clearer consumer decisions.
valueTest: Someone completes a useful activity, preserves something meaningful or takes a well-informed next step.
learnFrom: Completed value events, voluntary return use, trust and low support burden.

title: Business ownership
promise: Make owning a useful business more accessible and better informed.
description: We help builders, buyers and operators understand a business, question its economics and prepare the next ownership decision. Better evidence matters more than promising a deal or an exit.
valueTest: An operator or buyer accepts an evidence-linked decision or preparation artifact.
learnFrom: Decision usefulness, traceable evidence, repeat workflows and paid acceptance.
